_doc: The interview syllabus. Every clip must teach one of these items, or it is dropped. 'q' is the YouTube search query used for channel search. Sections 8 (Resume/HR) and 9 (languages, system design) are left out on purpose.

cpp.t: Pointers vs references
Dangling pointers, undefined behavior
RAII
Smart pointers: unique_ptr, shared_ptr, weak_ptr
Virtual functions, vtable, virtual destructors
Move semantics, rvalue references, Rule of 0/3/5
const, constexpr, static, inline, volatile
Stack vs heap, memory layout of a C program (text/data/bss/heap/stack)
cpp.q: memory layout of a C program stack heap

cpp.t: malloc/free vs new/delete
Templates (class, function, non-type params, variadic, fold expressions), overloading
Casts: static_cast vs dynamic_cast vs reinterpret_cast, RTTI
STL containers: complexities, vector growth, map vs unordered_map, iterator invalidation
Concurrency: std::thread, mutex, lock_guard/unique_lock, condition_variable, atomic, futures
Struct padding and alignment, sizeof puzzles
Compilation stages: preprocess, compile, assemble, link
Perfect forwarding, universal references, emplace_back vs push_back
Copy elision, RVO/NRVO
Placement new, custom deleters, memory/object pools, arena allocation
cpp.q: placement new memory pool arena allocator

cpp.t: Object slicing, virtual calls in constructors, diamond / virtual inheritance
Operator overloading, friend, mutable, this, PIMPL, CRTP, SOLID, lambdas and std::function

os.t: Process vs thread, PCB, context switch
CPU scheduling: FCFS, SJF, RR, priority, MLFQ
Synchronization: race conditions, mutex, semaphore, monitors, spinlocks
Classic problems: producer-consumer (bounded buffer), readers-writers, dining philosophers
os.q: producer consumer bounded buffer dining philosophers

os.t: Deadlock: 4 Coffman conditions, prevention, avoidance (Banker's), detection
Virtual memory, paging, page tables, TLB

os.q: page fault demand paging copy on write

os.t: Page replacement: FIFO, LRU, Optimal, Clock; thrashing
I/O multiplexing: select/poll/epoll, level vs edge triggered
File systems: inodes, hard vs soft links, journaling
os.q: inodes hard links journaling file system

os.t: User mode vs kernel mode, system calls, interrupts
IPC: pipes, shared memory, message queues
User-level vs kernel-level threads, thread-local storage
os.q: user level vs kernel level threads

os.t: Mutex implementation (futex), spinlock vs mutex, CAS/TAS, Peterson's algorithm
os.q: futex spinlock compare and swap Peterson

os.t: Disk scheduling (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN), RAID levels

cn.t: OSI vs TCP/IP models, what each layer does
TCP flow control (sliding window) vs congestion control (slow start, AIMD); Nagle and delayed ACK
cn.q: TCP congestion control slow start AIMD

cn.t: What happens when you type a URL (DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP)
cn.q: what happens when you type a URL

cn.t: DNS resolution: recursive vs iterative, caching
HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, HTTPS/TLS handshake
NAT, reverse proxy vs forward proxy
Sockets API: socket/bind/listen/accept/connect; TCP as a byte stream (framing)
MAC layer, Ethernet vs Wi-Fi (CSMA/CD vs CSMA/CA), switches vs routers vs hubs
Error detection: parity, checksum, CRC; Hamming code
Flow control and ARQ: stop-and-wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat
Network security: TLS, symmetric vs asymmetric, RSA, Diffie-Hellman, firewalls
Delays: transmission, propagation, queuing; bandwidth-delay product
Web infrastructure: load balancers, CDNs, caching

dbms.t: ACID properties
Keys: primary, candidate, foreign, super
Normalization: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF; functional dependencies
ER modeling
SQL: joins (inner/outer/self), GROUP BY/HAVING, subqueries
Window functions, CTEs, views, stored procedures, triggers
Classic queries: Nth highest salary, duplicates, running totals
NULL handling, set operations (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT)
Pagination: OFFSET vs keyset
SQL vs NoSQL, CAP theorem
Storage: disk vs SSD costs, RAID, slotted pages, buffer manager (why LRU fails), column stores
dbms.q: slotted pages buffer pool column store

dbms.t: Indexing: B+-tree (height, insert/split, delete), clustered vs secondary, hashing
LSM trees, Bloom filters, bitmap indices
Query processing: external sort-merge cost; nested-loop / block NL / index NL / merge / hash join costs
Query optimization: equivalence rules, histograms, size estimation, join ordering (DP), decorrelation
Transactions: schedules, conflict serializability, precedence graphs, recoverable and cascadeless schedules
Isolation levels and anomalies (dirty read, non-repeatable read, phantom, write skew)
Concurrency control: 2PL (strict, rigorous), lock manager, deadlocks, intention locks
Timestamp ordering, validation (OCC), MVCC, snapshot isolation
Recovery: WAL, steal/no-force, checkpoints, ARIES (PageLSN, CLRs)
Parallel and distributed: partitioning (range/hash), skew, parallel joins, MapReduce
Distributed transactions: 2PC and blocking, Raft, quorums, Spanner commit wait

coa.t: ISA: RISC vs CISC (MIPS vs x86)
Pipelining: 5 stages, hazards (structural, data, control), forwarding, stalls
Cache memory: hierarchy, locality, mapping (direct / set-associative / fully associative)
Cache write policies (write-through/back), replacement, miss types (3 Cs)
Number representation: two's complement, IEEE 754 floating point
Digital logic basics: gates, multiplexers, flip-flops, adders

aiml.t: Bayes' rule, base rates; common distributions
Expectation, variance, covariance; CLT; hypothesis tests and p-values
Gradients, convexity, gradient descent, learning rate; SGD vs momentum vs Adam
Linear and logistic regression (loss functions, why log-loss)
Choosing a model for a problem
Precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC vs PR-AUC; calibration
Neural network basics, activations, backprop and autodiff
CNNs: conv shape arithmetic, pooling, receptive field, residual connections
LLM pipeline end to end; BPE tokenization; embeddings
Self-attention and the causal mask; the transformer block
Sampling: temperature, top-k, top-p, beam search
Prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning: when to use which
Quantization formats and memory per weight
Serving metrics: TTFT, tokens/sec, latency vs throughput; cost estimates
The agent loop, function calling and schemas
Agent stop conditions, bounded loops, retries and error handling
RAG pipeline, chunking, embeddings and similarity
Vector indexes: exact, IVF, HNSW; BM25; hybrid search (RRF); re-ranking
Designing eval sets; code graders vs LLM judges
aiml.q: LLM evals LLM as a judge

aiml.t: Measuring non-deterministic systems; tracing and cost monitoring
Agentic coding tools: how they work, reviewing generated code
aiml.q: AI coding agents how they work
